environment.description: Container deployed with OCI runtime spec overrides via containerd RuntimeDefault seccomp profile and explicit capability drop list in the pod security context (drop: [NET_RAW, SYS_ADMIN]). The pod runs under a PodSecurity admission controller enforcing 'restricted' profile at warn level only. MongoDB instance uses SCRAM-SHA-256 authentication with a dedicated service account that has 'read' role exclusively on the 'artifacts' collection via MongoDB RBAC. The container's seccomp profile additionally restricts socket() syscalls to AF_INET/AF_INET6 with SOCK_STREAM only.

config.network_policy: allow ingress from ci-runner pods only on port 3000
